_meta.label: Prototype scoring model - not an official government formula
_meta.note: Composite red-zone score = sum(weight_h x hazard_subscore_h). Weights are configurable per regional hazard profile. Coastal erosion is not applicable to Assam and carries zero weight.

hazard_types.label: Flood
hazard_types.source: ASDMA daily bulletins, CWC flood forecasts
hazard_types.indicators: affected population, severity index, recurrence, 8 GIS overlay layers

hazard_types.label: Landslide
hazard_types.indicators: slope angle, soil saturation, past events, terrain instability

hazard_types.label: Cloudburst
hazard_types.indicators: peak rainfall intensity (mm/hr), short-duration extreme rainfall

hazard_types.label: Cyclone / Nor'wester
hazard_types.indicators: wind category, track proximity, landfall frequency

hazard_types.label: Earthquake
hazard_types.source: BIS/GSI seismic zonation (Assam: Zone V), BMTPC
hazard_types.data_status: Zone from BIS map; liquefaction proxy illustrative
hazard_types.indicators: seismic zone, soil liquefaction proxy, housing vulnerability

hazard_types.label: Fire (forest / urban)
hazard_types.indicators: fire alert frequency, proximity to habitation
